verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Batches submit endpoint that scrapes up to 25K URLs or crawls large sites asynchronously. A background batch guide covers progress tracking and retrieving Markdown or HTML when the job finishes, and timeout docs describe returning partial results with completion markers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large batch runs, and detailed docs on per-URL failure handling, retries, and completion notifications for batch jobs.
